name: Caddy Header Auth
description: Runs a Unix-socket forward_auth service under s6-overlay that invokes registered header-helper commands and returns their JSON headers to Caddy.

serviceUser.description: User that runs the service and executes header-helper commands: remote user, container user, vscode, then root; or an explicit existing user.

socketGroup.description: Group granted connect access to the Unix socket directory: caddy when present, otherwise the service user's primary group; or an explicit existing group.

socketPath.description: Absolute path of the Unix domain socket listened on by the service.

configDir.description: Absolute directory containing root-owned route JSON files (<route>.json).

timeoutSeconds.description: Default per-request timeout in seconds for each header-helper invocation (1 to 300).
